thought.text:
Ada 22 key dengan saldo $1 masing-masing. Saya tes dulu mana yang masih hidup dan cari base URL-nya.

Sambil itu, cek juga hasil GPU tadi.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && grep -rniE "nomask.*(url|endpoint|base)|api\.nomask|nomask\.ai" AKSES.md | head -6; echo "=== tes key teratas ==="; K="nmk_live_h6sUfOhMTBLD4GyNrx45jaeJDjhtMC6yCtfGegZC"; for u in "https://api.nomask.ai/v1/models" "https://nomask.ai/api/v1/models" "https://api.nomask.chat/v1/models"; do printf "%-40s " "$u"; curl -s --max-time 20 -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" "$u" -w "[%{http_code}]" | head -c 100; echo; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && grep -rniE \"nomask.*(url|endpoint|base)|api\\.nomask|nomask\\.ai\" AKSES.md | head -6; echo \"=== tes key teratas ===\"; K=\"nmk_live_h6sUfOhMTBLD4GyNrx45jaeJDjhtMC6yCtfGegZC\"; for u in \"https://api.nomask.ai/v1/models\" \"https://nomask.ai/api/v1/models\" \"https://api.nomask.chat/v1/models\"; do printf \"%-40s \" \"$u\"; curl -s --max-time 20 -H \"Authorization: Bearer $K\" \"$u\" -w \"[%{http_code}]\" | head -c 100; echo; done", "summary": "Find nomask base URL", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "timeout": 150}
